adversarial_classes.name: malformed_receipt_missing_identity
adversarial_classes.observed: Truncated JSON and a missing candidate ID rejected by the aggregation preflight in disposable receipt copies; CLI unknown artifact lookup also rejected.
adversarial_classes.scope: The helper does not parse native receipts; this is aggregation validation.

adversarial_classes.name: prompt_injection_data
adversarial_classes.observed: Literal hostile prompt preserved as an exact UTF-8 download; brand and subject escaped in generated HTML; zero script tags and no shell marker.
adversarial_classes.scope: No hostile native call and no model-level immunity claim.

adversarial_classes.name: fresh_process_saved_resume
adversarial_classes.observed: Six fresh helper show processes resumed catalog revision16 with identical saved state; no prompt regeneration or native calls.
adversarial_classes.scope: No forced runtime cancellation was needed.

adversarial_classes.name: stale_duplicate_collision
adversarial_classes.observed: Duplicate import and gallery IDs, stale revision15, missing artifact, existing destination, and a disposable metadata hash mismatch all rejected; no files overwritten and no stale-hash gallery remained.

adversarial_classes.name: dirty_worktree_preservation
adversarial_classes.observed: Already dirty shared tree recorded before/after; 785 baseline files remain byte-identical, including existing original gallery, native sources, brand/color gallery assets and implementation files.
adversarial_classes.scope: Concurrent documentation work is outside this owner; Markdown changes by those owners are not reverted.

adversarial_classes.name: bounded_commands_http
adversarial_classes.observed: Helper commands bounded to30seconds; curl connect2seconds/total10seconds; all34HTTP200 bodies hashed; only recorded own PID52715 stopped and port8801 rebind verified.
adversarial_classes.scope: Native workers had already settled; no cancellation or induced network-hang probe is applicable.

adversarial_classes.name: flaky_or_artistic_retry
adversarial_classes.observed: All five fixed new returned results retained at1254×1254, no artistic reroll or image transform, no synthetic source tests added.
adversarial_classes.scope: Creative stochastic behavior is not an automated pass/fail benchmark.

adversarial_classes.name: native_calls_vs_catalog_copies
adversarial_classes.observed: 16historical/native originals =11previous calls +5fresh returned calls; this catalog worker invoked0native calls and imported16catalog copies. Selection/review/export/color-report state is empty.
adversarial_classes.scope: No model identity, strict color, export, platform or artistic approval claim.

adversarial_classes.name: repeat_identity_resume
adversarial_classes.observed: Repeated per-receipt exact native paths, response hashes, prompts, source sessions and fixed attempt IDs unchanged; generationrevision0 kept separate from catalog expected revisions0–15.
adversarial_classes.scope: No interrupted native attempt was restarted or replaced.
